name: Camping Stubai
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Stubai is located in Neustift in the heart of the Stubaital valley. The park features clearly parcelled pitches for diverse vehicle categories, complemented by state-of-the-art sanitary amenities. A grocery shop and a restaurant are on site. The Stubaital is a renowned hub for alpine sports, boasting extensive summer hiking routes and guaranteed winter snow on the nearby Stubai Glacier.
